reviewer_comment: Review of 25 stratified cases found 4 coherent priority cases, 7 useful monitoring cases, 4 likely small-denominator false positives, 4 confirmed no-signal cases, 1 potential false negative and 5 insufficient-context cases. Add denominator support, review category point caps and reassess the volume peer gate before business-owner approval.

Candidate implements a minimum of 20 closed complaints for percentage rules, correlated-signal family caps, an eight-point priority boundary and exceptional-growth monitoring. Replay aligned all 9 reviewed cases targeted by the changes; further business and future-period validation remain required.
